description: Diplomatic reform scene content - nobles agree to sign constitution or they don't

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Everyone was seated around a long t..."
entries.dialogueText: Everyone was seated around a long table. They glanced around warily at each other, Manus, and the taxidermied animal heads looming above them.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You all know the real reason why w..."
entries.dialogueText: "You all know the real reason why we're here. Our citizens have long been demanding democracy. It is my duty as the monarch to ensure that transition."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I know all of you have your own pe..."
entries.dialogueText: "I know all of you have your own personal opinions and concerns about this. This is the time for you to speak your minds -- each and every one of you. So we can settle this once and for all."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Very well. Let's begin. Shall we,..."
entries.dialogueText: "Very well. Let's begin. Shall we, Mr. Sazon?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""If we want our monarchy to survive..."
entries.dialogueText: "If we want our monarchy to survive this century -- we must adapt. Truly empowering the House of Delegates and leaving the government to the people is the only way for our monarchy to survive."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We have gathered here on this mean..."
entries.dialogueText: "We have gathered here on this meaningful day to revolutionize our great kingdom and finally give the people of Rizia the right to rule themselves."

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""Your *duty*, Your Majesty? Let's n..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your *duty*, Your Majesty? Let's not go overboard."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""Interesting. I had no idea that be..."
entries.dialogueText: "Interesting. I had no idea that betraying the monarchy was one of the monarch's duties."

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""I will say right from the start th..."
entries.dialogueText: "I will say right from the start that His Majesty's opinion does not reflect that of the rest of House Toras."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""I will say right from the start th..."
entries.dialogueText: "I will say right from the start that I have my doubts about such a radical proposal."

entries.speaker: Angelica Sazon
entries.title: Angelica Sazon: ""The need for such a radical action..."
entries.dialogueText: "The need for such a radical action is by no means evident, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""The monarchy will stay in place, a..."
entries.dialogueText: "The monarchy will stay in place, and the monarch will act as the head of state. But the true political power of the government shall belong to the people."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""We are ready to listen. But you mu..."
entries.dialogueText: "We are ready to listen. But you must acknowledge that this is a tall request."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""We ask everyone at this table to c..."
entries.dialogueText: "We ask everyone at this table to cooperate and support the implementation of this constitution."

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""That's a lot to ask without offeri..."
entries.dialogueText: "That's a lot to ask without offering us anything in return."

entries.speaker: Angelica Sazon
entries.title: Angelica Sazon: ""You are starting to sound like you..."
entries.dialogueText: "You are starting to sound like your father, Manus. To a dangerous degree."

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""However, if the RPP and the royal..."
entries.dialogueText: "However, if the RPP and the royal houses can come to an agreement on this, we will not stand in their way."

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""Having said that, as long as we ca..."
entries.dialogueText: "Having said that, as long as we can reach an agreement here today, the RNC is ready to work with the RPP on implementing the new constitution."

entries.speaker: Leona Sazon
entries.title: Leona Sazon: ""I agree. I have supported you and..."
entries.dialogueText: "I agree. I have supported you and the RPP for years, but your current tone worries me."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""We understand the concerns. That i..."
entries.dialogueText: "We understand the concerns. That is the reason why I'm here today as a representative of the democratic movement. To show you that this movement is not against the monarchy."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""Thank you, Baroness de Rava.""
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you, Baroness de Rava."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""His Majesty already supports the c..."
entries.dialogueText: "His Majesty already supports the constitution. And I know Princess Vina has been sympathetic to the cause in the past."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""So... I would like to give the flo..."
entries.dialogueText: "So... I would like to give the floor to King Romus."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Mr. Sazon, you must admit that thi..."
entries.dialogueText: "Mr. Sazon, you must admit that this is incredibly ill timing. Our focus should be on the war, not reform."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""I did not leave the frontlines jus..."
entries.dialogueText: "I did not leave the frontlines just to listen to this populist drivel."

entries.speaker: Angelica Sazon
entries.title: Angelica Sazon: ""House Sazon will very gladly exerc..."
entries.dialogueText: "House Sazon will very gladly exercise that option."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""House Azaro is happy to exercise t..."
entries.dialogueText: "House Azaro is happy to exercise that option."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""House Azaro is very happy to exerc..."
entries.dialogueText: "House Azaro is very happy to exercise that option."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""As you wish, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "As you wish, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Not to interrupt, Your Majesty, bu..."
entries.dialogueText: "Not to interrupt, Your Majesty, but is that *really* your duty?"

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""If I may...""
entries.dialogueText: "If I may..."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""Drafted by the Rizian People's Par..."
entries.dialogueText: "Drafted by the Rizian People's Party, our renewed constitution represents the true will of Rizian citizens -- not only those born into wealth and power."

entries.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
entries.title: Carlos Robles Azaro: ""All due respect, Your Majesty, but..."
entries.dialogueText: "All due respect, Your Majesty, but this amounts to nothing less than a coup against our country's nobility."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""We are gathered here today because..."
entries.dialogueText: "We are gathered here today because the Rizian people have made their demands clear. If Rizia is going to continue as a kingdom, it must first ensure its citizens' right to self-determination."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""We see no alternative but to adapt..."
entries.dialogueText: "We see no alternative but to adapt with the changing times. We already have a parliament and elections. Rizia is too vast and diverse to be dictated by a monarch or council of appointed nobles alone. And the fact is, His Majesty agrees."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Manus cleared his throat and starte..."
entries.dialogueText: Manus cleared his throat and started speaking loudly, as if he were stating his case before the House of Delegates.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I looked around the table before sp..."
entries.dialogueText: I looked around the table before speaking.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Mr. Sazon has said it all. We need..."
entries.dialogueText: "Mr. Sazon has said it all. We need to adapt. A single person cannot dictate the will of Rizia alone anymore."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""First of all, I must point out tha..."
entries.dialogueText: "First of all, I must point out that we are not getting rid of the monarchy, nor the institutions that hold our kingdom together. I will transfer my legislative powers to the parliament and executive powers to the head of government, but I will remain the head of state."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Please take a look at what's happe..."
entries.dialogueText: "Please take a look at what's happening on the streets. People are discontent and they are organizing against our monarchy. The reality is clear as day."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Take a look at what's happening ou..."
entries.dialogueText: "Take a look at what's happening outside your estates. Millions are protesting and demanding democratic reforms. The reality is clear as day."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I acceded to the throne with the i..."
entries.dialogueText: "I acceded to the throne with the intention of reforming this country. The time for that transformation has finally come."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""When I took the throne, I had no i..."
entries.dialogueText: "When I took the throne, I had no intention of ceding any of my power. However, I am now convinced that I have a responsibility towards the Rizian people. And this transformation is necessary to adapt to the coming century."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""My father ignored the will of the..."
entries.dialogueText: "My father ignored the will of the people during his reign. His mistakes will not be repeated."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We cannot ignore the unrest, nor c..."
entries.dialogueText: "We cannot ignore the unrest, nor can we silence every voice that is raised against us. My father's mistakes will not be repeated."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I believe in incremental change, n..."
entries.dialogueText: "I believe in incremental change, not radical transformation. These reforms are merely a continuation of what my father accomplished. All of you will be able to carry on much as before."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I don't want to go down in history..."
entries.dialogueText: "I don't want to go down in history as another monarch who tried desperately to cling to power. It is my duty to ensure a smooth and peaceful transition."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The government may change, but the..."
entries.dialogueText: "The government may change, but the monarchy and the great legacies of the noble houses will not. We will still be the cornerstones of our kingdom's stability."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We must acknowledge that our syste..."
entries.dialogueText: "We must acknowledge that our system is inefficient. Absolute rule within the hands of a few cannot manage the intricacies of the 20th century."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Our hands have been forced, and fr..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our hands have been forced, and frankly, it's about time. As unfortunate it is, this is in the best interests of all of us."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Just because we are born into nobi..."
entries.dialogueText: "Just because we are born into nobility doesn't mean we are better suited to rule than anyone else. Rizia must slowly transform into a democracy."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Let's be honest. We all would pref..."
entries.dialogueText: "Let's be honest. We all would prefer to keep our massive wealth and our prestige as opposed to risking our heads trying to secure our political power, wouldn't we? Why even fight?"

entries.dialogueText: "Let's be honest. Would you prefer to keep your heads and your accumulated wealth as a noble family, or would you rather lose both?"

entries.title: Narrator: "General Taddeus and Angelica Sazon..."
entries.dialogueText: General Taddeus and Angelica Sazon both made tuts of disapproval.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "General Taddeus grunted in disappro..."
entries.dialogueText: General Taddeus grunted in disapproval.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Leona Sazon clicked her tongue in d..."
entries.dialogueText: Leona Sazon clicked her tongue in disapproval.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Angelica Sazon clicked her tongue i..."
entries.dialogueText: Angelica Sazon clicked her tongue in disapproval.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Uncle Hugo frowned in disapproval."
entries.dialogueText: Uncle Hugo frowned in disapproval.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Daria de Rava tutted in disapproval..."
entries.dialogueText: Daria de Rava tutted in disapproval.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Don't stand against change. Be a p..."
entries.dialogueText: "Don't stand against change. Be a part of it. I am asking you as your King."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""If we join forces together, we can..."
entries.dialogueText: "If we join forces together, we can show the world our unity and resilience. We have a choice to make, and according to it, we will go down in history as heroes or villains."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "They listened to me with no express..."
entries.dialogueText: They listened to me with no expression on their faces.

entries.dialogueText: "And what about the contents of this draft, Your Majesty? You are even abolishing the Royal Council..."

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""And what about the contents of thi..."
entries.dialogueText: "And what about the contents of this draft, Your Majesty? You are even abolishing the Royal Council..."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""And what about the contents of thi..."
entries.dialogueText: "And what about the contents of this draft, Your Majesty? The abolishment of the Royal Council strikes me as very extreme."

entries.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
entries.title: Carlos Robles Azaro: ""And what about the contents of thi..."
entries.dialogueText: "And what about the contents of this draft, Your Majesty? You are even abolishing the Royal Council..."

entries.speaker: Angelica Sazon
entries.title: Angelica Sazon: ""And what about the contents of thi..."
entries.dialogueText: "And what about the contents of this draft, Your Majesty? You are even abolishing the Royal Council..."

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""You have made your point clear. Sh..."
entries.dialogueText: "You have made your point clear. Shall we move on to discussing the contents of this draft?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I know you may not be fond of the..."
entries.dialogueText: "I know you may not be fond of the centralization measures. But they are a necessity to ensure the new government can exercise its powers efficiently and equally all across Rizia."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""Perhaps we should move on to discu..."
entries.dialogueText: "Perhaps we should move on to discussing the contents of the draft, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Patience. I'm getting there.""
entries.dialogueText: "Patience. I'm getting there."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Okay. What about it? Let's talk.""
entries.dialogueText: "Okay. What about it? Let's talk."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Let me finish.""
entries.dialogueText: "Let me finish."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Regarding the contents...""
entries.dialogueText: "Regarding the contents..."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Yes. Let's do that.""
entries.dialogueText: "Yes. Let's do that."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We are abolishing the Royal Counci..."
entries.dialogueText: "We are abolishing the Royal Council. Their powers will be transferred to a cabinet of ministers appointed by the head of government."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""There will no longer be appointed..."
entries.dialogueText: "There will no longer be appointed nobles who can exercise executive powers. The government will be formed by the people, for the people."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Yes. The council will be abolished..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes. The council will be abolished. Instead, the new head of government, the Prime Minister will form a cabinet and lead the ministers."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We will also centralize Rizia's re..."
entries.dialogueText: "We will also centralize Rizia's regional structure and abolish the semi-autonomy of each province."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The Houses will no longer enjoy en..."
entries.dialogueText: "The Houses will no longer enjoy enormous authority and privileges in their respective provinces. We will abolish the autonomous structure and centralize out government in Porte Drazon."

entries.title: Rico Toras: ""I can't believe this point is up f..."
entries.dialogueText: "I can't believe this point is up for discussion."

entries.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
entries.title: Carlos Robles Azaro: ""Outrageous...""
entries.dialogueText: "Outrageous..."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""Unbelievable...""
entries.dialogueText: "Unbelievable..."

entries.speaker: Angelica Sazon

entries.dialogueText: "Too much, Your Majesty. Just too much."

entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The nobility will be represented i..."
entries.dialogueText: "The nobility will be represented in the House of Lords, and will act as a balance to the lower house. Any legislation would require both houses to come to an agreement."

entries.dialogueText: "We will form an upper house consisting of the nobility. Each of the royal houses will therefore continue to be represented in the legislative branch."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""As the monarch, I will retain the..."
entries.dialogueText: "As the monarch, I will retain the final say over any legislation in order to protect the integrity of our kingdom."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I will reign as a symbolic monarch..."
entries.dialogueText: "I will reign as a symbolic monarch only. The parliament of this country will have the final say in legislature."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: "I will remain the head of state, represent our kingdom in the international arena and protect our royal traditions."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The legislative branch will freely..."
entries.dialogueText: "The legislative branch will freely represent the people and take actions accordingly within the scope of the constitution."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""As a compromise, the legislative b..."
entries.dialogueText: "As a compromise, the legislative branch will be divided into two. Nobles and commoners will be given an equal voice."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The nobility will be represented i..."
entries.dialogueText: "The nobility will be represented in the House of Lords and will act as a balance to the lower house. Any constitutional or structural changes will require their -- your -- agreement."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""As a compromise, the legislative b..."
entries.dialogueText: "As a compromise, the legislative branch will be divided into two. The nobility will retain a say over the parliament's decisions, albeit a limited one."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The nobility will be represented i..."
entries.dialogueText: "The nobility will be represented in the House of Lords and will act as an advisory body to the lower house."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""As a compromise, the legislative b..."
entries.dialogueText: "As a compromise, the legislative branch will be divided into two. The nobility will be given an advisory role with the establishment of an upper house."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""As a compromise, the legislative b..."
entries.dialogueText: "As a compromise, the legislative branch will be divided into two. The provinces will be given a voice with the establishment of an upper house, retaining a significant say in government."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We will form an upper house consis..."
entries.dialogueText: "We will form an upper house consisting of representatives from each province to create a bicameral legislature."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: "Rizia's individual provinces will be represented in the Senate  and will act as a balance to the lower house. Any legislation would require both houses to come to an agreement."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The provinces will be represented..."
entries.dialogueText: "The provinces will be represented in parliament and will act as a balance to the lower house. Any constitutional or structural changes will require their agreement."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""As a compromise, the legislative b..."
entries.dialogueText: "As a compromise, the legislative branch will be divided into two. The provinces will be given a voice with the establishment of an upper house, retaining a limited say in government."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The regions will be represented in..."
entries.dialogueText: "The regions will be represented in the Senate and will act as an advisory body to the lower house."

entries.title: Player_Romus: ""As a compromise, the legislative b..."
entries.dialogueText: "As a compromise, the legislative branch will be divided into two and the regions will be given an advisory role with the establishment of an upper house."

entries.title: Narrator: "Rico was furiously whispering into..."
entries.dialogueText: Rico was furiously whispering into the ear of Uncle Hugo.

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras

entries.dialogueText: "Our newly established judicial branch will ensure that the constitution is being followed by the other branches of government."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We'll form a Supreme Court, and we..."
entries.dialogueText: "We'll form a Supreme Court, and we will give the justices immunity so that they cannot be threatened by powerful interests or the acting executive."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We'll form the Supreme Court and w..."
entries.dialogueText: "We'll form the Supreme Court and we will grant the judges life tenure, which will free them from the pressure of protecting powerful interests or making decisions according to momentary populism."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We will form a Supreme Court. Just..."
entries.dialogueText: "We will form a Supreme Court. Justices will be granted the power of judicial review and to declare laws unconstitutional, so that they can keep the legislative and the executive branches in check."

entries.dialogueText: "We will form a Supreme Court. I will retain control over its composition, so that the monarchy can keep the legislative and the executive branches in check."

entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""You royals and your obsession with..."
entries.dialogueText: "You royals and your obsession with breeding... It's as if it were a pack of prize greyhounds leading the country."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Adarfo fixed him with a bemused exp..."
entries.dialogueText: Adarfo fixed him with a bemused expression.

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""You and His Majesty are asking us..."
entries.dialogueText: "You and His Majesty are asking us to swallow some very dramatic changes. I won't stand for the upending of tradition on top of all that."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""Please just answer the question.""
entries.dialogueText: "Please just answer the question."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Vina let out an excited gasp."
entries.dialogueText: Vina let out an excited gasp.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Adarfo took a slow glance around th..."
entries.dialogueText: Adarfo took a slow glance around the room, his eyes finally coming to rest on me.

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""Let the history books show that yo..."
entries.dialogueText: "Let the history books show that you had a chance for peace. And that you rejected it out of your own selfish interests."

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""I knew this was never going to wor..."
entries.dialogueText: "I knew this was never going to work your way."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "With a scowl, he stormed out the tr..."
entries.dialogueText: With a scowl, he stormed out the trophy room doors.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "A tear trickled down my daughter's..."
entries.dialogueText: A tear trickled down my daughter's face. Manus embraced her tightly.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "My uncle made an effort to smile."
entries.dialogueText: My uncle made an effort to smile.

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""We should rejoin your mother and t..."
entries.dialogueText: "We should rejoin your mother and the others. We still have a birthday to celebrate."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""You made an admirable effort, Romu..."
entries.dialogueText: "You made an admirable effort, Romus. Your willingness to listen and compromise will serve you well in the next years of your reign."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""My instincts told me not to return..."
entries.dialogueText: "My instincts told me not to return to Porte Drazon. I should have listened to them..."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "My uncle made an effort to turn his..."
entries.dialogueText: My uncle made an effort to turn his grimace into a smile.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Hugo got to his feet with a smile."
entries.dialogueText: Hugo got to his feet with a smile.

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Congratulations to everyone in thi..."
entries.dialogueText: "Congratulations to everyone in this room. It will take some time to get used to it, but I am looking forward to seeing what the future of Rizia holds."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""I suggest we return to the celebra..."
entries.dialogueText: "I suggest we return to the celebrations."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Hugo stood and offered a strained s..."
entries.dialogueText: Hugo stood and offered a strained smile. The disappointment in his eyes said more than words ever could.

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Congratulations to everyone in thi..."
entries.dialogueText: "Congratulations to everyone in this room. House Toras knows better than to interfere with the course of history."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Titus and his guards pushed the doo..."
entries.dialogueText: Titus and his guards pushed the doors open for us.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "As we stepped back into the atrium,..."
entries.dialogueText: As we stepped back into the atrium, the nobles gathered there broke into polite applause.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You have made the right choice. Th..."
entries.dialogueText: "You have made the right choice. The historians will write glowingly of this moment."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I look forward to reigning over ou..."
entries.dialogueText: "I look forward to reigning over our newly emancipated populace."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'll miss your subservience. Just..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'll miss your subservience. Just for old times' sake, I command you to applaud."

entries.title: Player_Romus: ""As for those of you who did not si..."
entries.dialogueText: "As for those of you who did not sign, your names and Houses will be remembered."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I knew that we could solve this wi..."
entries.dialogueText: "I knew that we could solve this without having to resort to violence."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""Yes, I thank you all for your will..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, I thank you all for your willingness to cooperate."

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""Not that you had an alternative.""
entries.dialogueText: "Not that you had an alternative."

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""We will move forward with the tran..."
entries.dialogueText: "We will move forward with the transition very soon."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""We could never have done this with..."
entries.dialogueText: "We could never have done this without you, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""Not true. But your cooperation and..."
entries.dialogueText: "Not true. But your cooperation and that of the other nobles definitely made things easier."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Adarfo barely hid a smirk."
entries.dialogueText: Adarfo barely hid a smirk.

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""Yes... we have truly come a long w..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes... we have truly come a long way since the 1920s."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Everyone around the table applauded..."
entries.dialogueText: Everyone around the table applauded with a burst of nervous laughter.

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""His Majesty means to say that the..."
entries.dialogueText: "His Majesty means to say that the reforms will benefit everyone. You will come to see their value in the end."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Adarfo had a thin-lipped smile on h..."
entries.dialogueText: Adarfo had a thin-lipped smile on his face.

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""His Majesty has spoken.""
entries.dialogueText: "His Majesty has spoken."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""Uh... His Majesty has spoken.""
entries.dialogueText: "Uh... His Majesty has spoken."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""The RPP will present the reform pr..."
entries.dialogueText: "The RPP will present the reform proposal in the House of Delegates soon. I promise you will all come to see the good in these changes."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Manus and Vina exchanged looks of t..."
entries.dialogueText: Manus and Vina exchanged looks of trepidation.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He looked at me in trepidation."
entries.dialogueText: He looked at me in trepidation.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Thank you nonetheless for joining..."
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you nonetheless for joining me here."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""None of you had better even think..."
entries.dialogueText: "None of you had better even think about trying to stop me. There will be consequences."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Now let's get back out there and c..."
entries.dialogueText: "Now let's get back out there and celebrate the Queen Mother's birthday, shall we?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""This is for everyone's own good.""
entries.dialogueText: "This is for everyone's own good."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "My fellow nobles bowed as they left..."
entries.dialogueText: My fellow nobles bowed as they left the room -- some with genuine deference, others with an air of defiance.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""I will still support you. Even if..."
entries.dialogueText: "I will still support you. Even if nobody else does."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "When almost everyone had left, Luci..."
entries.dialogueText: When almost everyone had left, Lucita came up to me and shook her head in disappointment.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""I understand why you did what you..."
entries.dialogueText: "I understand why you did what you did. But there must have been a better way."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She rushed past me and back into th..."
entries.dialogueText: She rushed past me and back into the library.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I felt myself fill with resolve."
entries.dialogueText: I felt myself fill with resolve.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I would see these reforms through...."
entries.dialogueText: I would see these reforms through. No matter what.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You will regret this. All of you.""
entries.dialogueText: "You will regret this. All of you."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I thank you all nonetheless for jo..."
entries.dialogueText: "I thank you all nonetheless for joining me here today."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The voice of the Rizian people wil..."
entries.dialogueText: "The voice of the Rizian people will not be silenced. This is not over."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I won't hold any of you individual..."
entries.dialogueText: "I won't hold any of you individually responsible for this. We can just carry on as if nothing happened."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "My fellow nobles bowed as they left..."
entries.dialogueText: My fellow nobles bowed as they left the room -- some with genuine deference, others with an air of defiance.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "As I headed back out into the libra..."
entries.dialogueText: As I headed back out into the library, I felt the full weight of the crown on my head.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "For now, it was still mine to bear."
entries.dialogueText: For now, it was still mine to bear.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Adarfo smiled patiently."
entries.dialogueText: Adarfo smiled patiently.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I locked eyes with Titus and gave h..."
entries.dialogueText: I locked eyes with Titus and gave him the smallest of nods. Understanding, he moved with practiced silence, positioning himself by the door.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I locked eyes with one of Adarfo's..."
entries.dialogueText: I locked eyes with one of Adarfo's men, who was disguised as a server, and gave him the smallest of nods.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I locked eyes with one of Adarfo's..."
entries.dialogueText: I locked eyes with one of Adarfo's men who was already inside the room, blending in with the security guards. I gave him the smallest of nods.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I heard the doors click shut."
entries.dialogueText: I heard the doors click shut.
